notes:
Purchase/Sales GST Summary: Journal-booked vouchers now counted.

Root cause of "0 vendors, 0 vouchers" in Purchase GST Summary (and the equivalent gap in Sales GST Summary): a business that books purchases/sales through a Journal voucher instead of the dedicated Purchase/Sales voucher type had every one of those vouchers silently excluded.

Fixed: a Journal voucher now also counts as a purchase/sale if it carries at least one CGST/SGST/IGST/Cess line — a plain provision/accrual journal has none, so unrelated entries aren't pulled in.

Verified live against a real running Tally instance before this release: Purchase GST Summary went from 0 vendors/0 vouchers to 11 vendors/22 vouchers with correct tax totals; Sales GST Summary went from missing data to 134 clients/220 vouchers.
